traceability.notes: This file is a concrete specification for the core function-annotation rules and is fully implemented. The project defines two ESLint rules, require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation, which share a common function-detection set, JSDoc/comment parsing strategy, configurable scope and exportPriority behavior, and robust TypeScript support. Advanced @req detection heuristics (linesBeforeHasReq, parentChainHasReq, fallbackTextBeforeHasReq, hasReqAnnotation) are implemented and covered by dedicated unit tests. Error messages are clear and reported at the function name for precise location, and extensive edge-case tests ensure graceful error handling. Both rules are documented with examples and options and are integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict presets. All associated test suites tied to docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md pass, providing strong evidence that all acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in this story are satisfied.
